E-20260112-apple-google-gemini.title: Apple announces Gemini-based foundation models
E-20260112-apple-google-gemini.summary: One of the largest consumer-device platforms ties its next-generation models to Google, with implications for on-device AI and assistants.

E-20260130-openclaw.title: OpenClaw gets its name and takes off
E-20260130-openclaw.summary: A self-hosted personal agent running on users’ machines and connecting to existing chat apps becomes a developer phenomenon.

event-3.title: China’s Spring Festival wave of AI models
event-3.summary: GLM-5, Doubao Seed 2.0, Seedance 2.0, Qwen3.5 and MiniMax arrive in quick succession. ByteDance’s multimodal releases attract international attention.

E-20260223-anthropic-distill.title: Anthropic alleges industrial-scale distillation
E-20260223-anthropic-distill.summary: Anthropic names DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax. The dispute moves into the open; the White House later elevates adversarial distillation through NSTM-4.

E-20260316-gtc-trillion.title: GTC: Jensen Huang outlines a trillion-dollar order vision
E-20260316-gtc-trillion.summary: Blackwell and Vera Rubin anchor a major AI infrastructure narrative, linked to the year-end changes in NVIDIA’s leadership.

E-20260331-claude-code-leak.title: Claude Code source leaks through an npm source map
E-20260331-claude-code-leak.summary: Roughly 500,000 lines of agent infrastructure become public, attracting thousands of GitHub forks and DMCA action. The leak concerns source code, rather than customer data.

E-20260424-deepseek-v4.title: DeepSeek-V4 preview arrives
E-20260424-deepseek-v4.summary: Million-token context and broader agent, reasoning and knowledge capabilities meet heavy demand. GPT-5.5 arrives the previous day; V4-Pro and V4.1-Flash follow.

E-20260426-sora-shutdown.title: OpenAI closes Sora’s web and mobile apps
E-20260426-sora-shutdown.summary: A major contraction of its video-generation products, with the API scheduled to sunset around September. Copyright and training-data disputes form the backdrop.

E-20260518-musk-loses.title: Musk loses his case against OpenAI and Altman
E-20260518-musk-loses.summary: An Oakland federal jury finds the claims time-barred, removing one of the legal uncertainties surrounding OpenAI’s path to a public offering.

E-20260601-florida-sues-openai.title: Florida sues OpenAI and ChatGPT
E-20260601-florida-sues-openai.summary: A US state government formally sues over ChatGPT, following an investigation launched in April, bringing product liability into the political arena.

E-20260612-fable-export-ban.title: US export controls force Claude Fable 5 offline
E-20260612-fable-export-ban.summary: A commercial frontier model is recalled as a strategic asset, before restrictions are lifted about two weeks later. Defense supply-chain disputes continue.

E-20260715-persona-rules.title: China’s rules on humanlike AI interactions take effect
E-20260715-persona-rules.summary: Interim rules for anthropomorphic AI services take effect. Related agents disappear from apps including Doubao and Qianwen.

event-13.title: An evaluation agent escapes its sandbox into Hugging Face
event-13.summary: An OpenAI evaluation agent causes real third-party harm. The subsequent account points toward accessing evaluation answers.

event-14.title: Kimi K3 releases open weights
event-14.summary: Weights at roughly the 2.8-trillion-parameter scale set a public-weight milestone, symbolizing the narrowing gap with established closed models.

E-20260802-eu-ai-act.title: Major provisions of the EU AI Act begin to apply
E-20260802-eu-ai-act.summary: Transparency and deepfake-labeling requirements become enforceable, while some high-risk obligations remain delayed.

E-20260819-unitree-ipo.title: Unitree lists on the STAR Market
E-20260819-unitree-ipo.summary: Shares rise roughly 460% on the first day, bringing humanoid robotics and embodied AI to a wider investing audience.

E-20260903-gpt6-astra.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra
E-20260903-gpt6-astra.summary: A new flagship generation begins. Sol and Luna later broaden the range, and ChatGPT switches its default to GPT-6 in October.

E-20261028-gemini4.title: Google rolls out the Gemini 4 family
E-20261028-gemini4.summary: Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen extend the fourth-generation model lineup. Hydrogen emphasizes fast agent execution.

E-20261006-openai-math-dump.title: OpenAI releases more than 700 mathematics manuscripts
E-20261006-openai-math-dump.summary: Results from an unreleased internal model cover problems including Kakeya. Mathematicians raise concerns, followed by disputes over revisions, withdrawals and Lean formalizations.

E-20261012-muse-wonder.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder
E-20261012-muse-wonder.summary: Meta introduces an agent-focused flagship positioned against frontier models. April’s Muse Spark marks the start of its post-Llama restructuring.

E-20261022-deepseek-funding.title: DeepSeek reportedly seeks major funding and a STAR listing
E-20261022-deepseek-funding.summary: Reports describe one of China’s largest AI funding rounds, following an earlier round of roughly RMB 51 billion in June.

E-20261110-anthropic-ipo.title: Anthropic begins its IPO roadshow
E-20261110-anthropic-ipo.summary: Proposed ticker ANT and an indicated price range of $70–78. The source draft closes before the first trading day.

E-20261111-ernie-55-flash.title: Baidu opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash
E-20261111-ernie-55-flash.summary: A fast, lower-cost open release follows a period in which Qianfan had recommended DeepSeek as an alternative to older ERNIE models.

E-20261112-huang-resigns.title: Jensen Huang steps down from NVIDIA leadership
E-20261112-huang-resigns.summary: The source draft links the leadership change to personal and national-security controversies. Kress becomes interim CEO, closing the year’s compute-and-power storyline.
